odc_type: Incorrect parameter usage in array copy operation
observation_summary: The application throws a StringIndexOutOfBoundsException or ArrayIndexOutOfBoundsException when appending a string longer than the specified fixed width.
reasoning_summary: The code intended to copy a fixed-width portion of a string into a buffer. When the string length exceeded the specified width, the code incorrectly used the full string length as the end index for the 'getChars' method instead of the specified width. This caused an attempt to copy more characters than the allocated buffer space allowed, leading to an ArrayIndexOutOfBoundsException.
